# Split button (`split-button`)

A main action with a menu of alternatives.

Group: Overlays. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/overlays';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createSplitButton` (types in `dist/web/overlays/splitButton.d.ts`): `.mh-split-button` (`role="group"`): a main action (`__main`) joined to a menu button (`__toggle`, a chevron) that opens a `.mh-menu` of alternatives ("Run scene" with "Run in 10 minutes", "Edit scene"). Both halves are real buttons in the Tab order; the menu button has the menu-button keyboard (Enter, Space, Arrow Down / Up).

```ts
export function createSplitButton(options: SplitButtonOptions): SplitButtonHandle;

export interface SplitButtonOptions {
  /** The main action's label. */
  label: string;
  icon?: IconName | string;
  variant?: SplitButtonVariant;
  size?: ButtonSize;
  /** The alternatives in the menu. */
  items: readonly MenuEntry[];
  /** Accessible name of the menu button. Default "More options". */
  menuLabel?: string;
  /** Default `bottom-end`; flips when there's no room. */
  placement?: MenuPlacement;
  disabled?: boolean;
  /** The main action. */
  onClick?: (event: MouseEvent) => void;
  /** An alternative was chosen from the menu. */
  onSelect?: (value: string) => void;
  /** Portals the menu into the nearest `[data-mh-theme]` ancestor of this element. */
  container?: HTMLElement | null;
}

export interface SplitButtonHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  button: HTMLButtonElement;
  toggle: HTMLButtonElement;
  menu: MenuHandle;
  setLabel(label: string): void;
  setItems(items: readonly MenuEntry[]): void;
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
  destroy(): void;
}

export type MenuEntry = MenuItem | MenuSeparator;

export interface MenuHandle {
  el: HTMLElement;
  open(focus?: 'first' | 'last'): void;
  close(): void;
  isOpen(): boolean;
  setItems(items: readonly MenuEntry[]): void;
  /** Detaches the menu and its listeners from the anchor. */
  destroy(): void;
}

export interface MenuItem {
  value: string;
  label: string;
  icon?: IconName | string;
  /** Shown on the right, e.g. "Ctrl+D". Display only. */
  shortcut?: string;
  danger?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
}
```

`h` (types in `dist/web/dom.d.ts`): Creates an element: string and number attributes are set, `true` sets an empty attribute, `on*` functions become listeners.

```ts
export function h<K extends keyof HTMLElementTagNameMap>(tag: K, attrs: Attrs = {}, ...children: Child[]): HTMLElementTagNameMap[K];
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createSplitButton, h } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const status = h('p', { 'aria-live': 'polite' });

const runScene = createSplitButton({
  label: 'Run scene',
  icon: 'play',
  items: [
    { value: 'in-10', label: 'Run in 10 minutes', icon: 'refresh' },
    { value: 'at-sunset', label: 'Run at sunset', icon: 'weather' },
    { separator: true },
    { value: 'edit', label: 'Edit scene', icon: 'edit' },
  ],
  onClick: () => (status.textContent = 'Evening scene is running'),
  onSelect: (value) => (status.textContent = `Chosen: ${value}`),
});

document.body.append(runScene.el, status);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { SplitButton } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';
import type { MenuEntry } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const items: MenuEntry[] = [
  { value: 'in-10', label: 'Run in 10 minutes', icon: 'refresh' },
  { value: 'at-sunset', label: 'Run at sunset', icon: 'weather' },
  { separator: true },
  { value: 'edit', label: 'Edit scene', icon: 'edit' },
];

export function SplitButtonExample() {
  const [status, setStatus] = useState('');
  return (
    <>
      <SplitButton
        label="Run scene"
        icon="play"
        items={items}
        onClick={() => setStatus('Evening scene is running')}
        onSelect={(value) => setStatus(`Chosen: ${value}`)}
      />
      <p aria-live="polite">{status}</p>
    </>
  );
}
```
